## EXTERNAL VALIDATION OF RRS

### Metadata harmonization
Validation cohort metadata were extracted from the GEO series matrix file and reformatted into a sample-level metadata table. GEO “characteristics” annotation fields were parsed to recover participant identifiers, demographic variables, pain outcome classifications, and longitudinal timepoint information. The resulting metadata structure provided harmonized GSM identifiers and paired longitudinal sample information for downstream RRS scoring analyses.
```{r}
library(data.table)

# load GEO series matrix for the validation cohort as a data.table 
meta <- fread("Validation Cohort/GSE177034_series_matrix.txt.gz", 
              sep="\t", fill=TRUE, quote="")

# keep only metadata rows (those starting with !)
meta_only <- meta[grep("^!", meta$V1), ]

# Ksubset to sample-level annoation rows (begings with !Sample_)
sample_rows <- meta_only[grepl("^!Sample_", V1)]

# ensure sample metadata keys are unique before transposing 
sample_rows$V1 <- make.unique(sample_rows$V1, sep = "_")

# extract row names and transpose
row_ids <- sub("^!Sample_", "", sample_rows$V1)

# transpose sample metadata so samples are rows and fields are columns 
val_mat <- t(as.matrix(sample_rows[, -1, with = FALSE]))

# convert to data.table and set columns names from metadata
sample_meta <- as.data.table(val_mat)
setnames(sample_meta, row_ids)


# function: remove quotes and the "field: " prefix from a metadata string
extract_value <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('"', '', x) 
  sub("^[^:]+: ?", "", x)
}

# parse key sample-level fields from GEO "characteristics_ch1" columns
meta_parsed <- sample_meta %>%
  mutate(
    individual = extract_value(characteristics_ch1),
    Sex = extract_value(characteristics_ch1_1),
    age = as.numeric(extract_value(characteristics_ch1_2)),
    smoking = extract_value(characteristics_ch1_3),
    paingroup = extract_value(characteristics_ch1_4),
    timepoint = extract_value(characteristics_ch1_5)) %>%
  dplyr::select(geo_accession, title, individual, paingroup, timepoint, age) 

# clean up any leading/trailing quotes
meta_parsed$geo_accession <- gsub('^"|"$', "", meta_parsed$geo_accession)
meta_parsed$title  <- gsub('^"|"$', "", meta_parsed$title)

# final clean metadata 
validation_meta <- meta_parsed %>%
  transmute(
    GSM  = geo_accession,
    SampleTitle  = title,
    IndividualID = individual,
    Timepoint = timepoint, # t0 / t1
    Outcome = paingroup, # Persistent or Resolved
    Age = age)
```

### Define external recovery phenotypes
PainOMICs longitudinal pain severity data were used to define recovery and chronic outcome groups within the external cohort. Multiple threshold combinations based on baseline pain severity, follow-up pain severity, and longitudinal pain change were explored to assess cohort balance and recovery/chronic group distributions. Participants with high baseline pain and low follow-up pain were classified as “Recovered_extreme,” whereas participants with persistently high pain at follow-up were classified as “Chronic_extreme.” All remaining participants were classified as “Intermediate.”
```{r}
load("Validation Cohort/epid.R")
# show all columns
colnames( epid )
# 
# MEAN.daily.pain.intensity.t0
# NOW.pain.intensity.t0
# MEAN.daily.pain.intensity.t1NC
# NOW.pain.intensity.t1NC

epid_pain <- epid %>%
  dplyr::rename(IndividualID = RNA.Samples.t0) %>%
  dplyr::select(IndividualID, Gender,
    mean_t0 = MEAN.daily.pain.intensity.t0,
    mean_t1 = MEAN.daily.pain.intensity.t1NC,
    now_t0 = NOW.pain.intensity.t0,
    now_t1 = NOW.pain.intensity.t1NC) %>%
  mutate(mean_change = mean_t1 - mean_t0,
         now_change  = now_t1 - now_t0)

validation_meta_pain <- validation_meta %>%
  left_join(epid_pain, by = "IndividualID")

external_pain <- validation_meta_pain %>%
  dplyr::select(IndividualID, Gender, mean_t0, mean_t1, mean_change) %>%
  distinct()

summary(external_pain$mean_t0)
summary(external_pain$mean_t1)
summary(external_pain$mean_change)

table(external_pain$mean_t0)
table(external_pain$mean_t1)

threshold_grid <- expand.grid(
  t0_thresh = 6,
  t1_low_thresh = 0:3,     # recovered threshold
  t1_high_thresh = 6:8,    # chronic threshold
  change_thresh = -6:-2)

threshold_results <- threshold_grid %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    recovered_flag = list(
      external_pain$mean_t0 >= t0_thresh &
      external_pain$mean_t1 <= t1_low_thresh &
      external_pain$mean_change <= change_thresh),
    chronic_flag = list(
      external_pain$mean_t0 >= t0_thresh &
      external_pain$mean_t1 >= t1_high_thresh &
      external_pain$mean_change >= -1),
    n_recovered = sum(unlist(recovered_flag)),
    n_chronic = sum(unlist(chronic_flag)),
    overlap = sum(unlist(recovered_flag) & unlist(chronic_flag)),
    intermediates = nrow(external_pain) - (n_recovered + n_chronic - overlap)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-recovered_flag, -chronic_flag)


external_pain <- external_pain %>%
  mutate(External_Group = case_when(
    mean_t0 >= 6 & mean_t1 <= 2 ~ "Recovered_extreme",
    mean_t0 >= 6 & mean_t1 >= 6 ~ "Chronic_extreme",
    TRUE ~ "Intermediate"))

table(external_pain$External_Group)

external_pain %>%
  group_by(External_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_t0 = mean(mean_t0),
    mean_t1 = mean(mean_t1),
    mean_change = mean(mean_change))
```

### External RNA-seq preprocessing
Raw RNA-seq count data from the validation cohort were imported and converted from Entrez identifiers to HGNC gene symbols. Expression values were log2 transformed following pseudocount addition. Longitudinally paired participants with both baseline (t0) and follow-up (t1) RNA samples present in the expression matrix were retained for downstream analyses. Genes overlapping the locked RRS gene signature were identified and extracted for external scoring.
```{r}
# Locked weights from internal extreme-phenotype model
beta_vec <- beta_vec_final
stopifnot(!is.null(names(beta_vec)))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(names(beta_vec)) == 0)

# Load raw count matrix
validation_RNA_raw <- read.table("Validation Cohort/GSE177034_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv",
                                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert Entrez ID to HGNC symbol
validation_RNA_raw$GeneSymbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = as.character(validation_RNA_raw$GeneID),
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  multiVals = "first")

validation_RNA_log2 <- validation_RNA_raw %>%
  relocate(GeneSymbol, .before = GeneID) %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol), GeneSymbol != "")

validation_RNA_log2[, -1] <- log2(validation_RNA_log2[, -1] + 1)

dim(validation_RNA_log2) # 37692   196

# RNA sample IDs present in expression matrix
rna_samples <- setdiff(colnames(validation_RNA_log2), "GeneSymbol")

# paired metadata with both timepoints represented in RNA
meta_paired <- validation_meta %>%
  mutate(in_expr = GSM %in% rna_samples) %>%
  group_by(IndividualID) %>%
  filter(
    n() == 2,
    all(in_expr),
    all(c("t0", "t1") %in% Timepoint)) %>%
  ungroup()

nrow(meta_paired) #194
length(unique(meta_paired$IndividualID)) #97

valid_gsms <- meta_paired$GSM

expr_paired <- validation_RNA_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneSymbol, all_of(valid_gsms))

(all(colnames(expr_paired)[-1] == meta_paired$GSM)) # true 

genes_matched <- intersect(expr_paired$GeneSymbol, names(beta_vec))
genes_missing <- setdiff(names(beta_vec), expr_paired$GeneSymbol)

length(genes_matched) # 43
length(genes_missing) # 3
genes_missing  #"ENSG00000288887" "PKD1P5"  "RPL17.C18orf32" 
```

### External validation of the RRS
The locked RRS beta vector derived from the AURORA extreme phenotype model was applied directly to the external PainOMICs cohort without retraining or coefficient modification. Participant-level longitudinal gene expression changes (t1 − t0) were calculated for overlapping RRS genes and multiplied by the corresponding locked beta coefficients to generate participant-level RRS values. RRS distributions were then compared across persistent versus resolved pain outcomes and across externally defined recovery phenotype groups.
```{r}
genes_matched <- final_stable_genes

expr_scoring <- expr_paired %>%
  filter(GeneSymbol %in% genes_matched)

dim(expr_scoring)

expr_long <- expr_scoring %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -GeneSymbol, names_to = "GSM", values_to = "expr") %>%
  left_join(meta_paired, by = "GSM")

expr_delta_long <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneSymbol, IndividualID, Outcome, Timepoint, expr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = expr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(t0), !is.na(t1)) %>%
  mutate(delta = t1 - t0)

expr_delta_long <- expr_delta_long %>%
  left_join(tibble(GeneSymbol = names(beta_vec),
                   beta = as.numeric(beta_vec)),
            by = "GeneSymbol") %>%
  filter(!is.na(beta))

RRS_validation <- expr_delta_long %>%
  mutate(weighted_delta = delta * beta) %>%
  group_by(IndividualID, Outcome) %>%
  summarise(RRS = sum(weighted_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_genes_used = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

RRS_validation <- RRS_validation %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Resolved", "Persistent")))

RRS_validation %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_RRS = mean(RRS),
    sd_RRS = sd(RRS),
    mean_genes_used = mean(n_genes_used))

t.test(RRS ~ Outcome, data = RRS_validation)
# t = 2.1127, df = 85.42, p-value = 0.03754


RRS_validation_extreme <- RRS_validation %>%
  left_join(external_pain, by = "IndividualID")

anova(lm(RRS ~ External_Group, data = RRS_validation_extreme))
#               Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value  Pr(>F)  
# External_Group  2  2.344 1.17198  4.4013 0.01489 *

pairwise.t.test(
  RRS_validation_extreme$RRS,
  RRS_validation_extreme$External_Group,
  p.adjust.method = "holm")

RRS_validation_extreme_only <- RRS_validation_extreme %>%
  filter(External_Group %in% c("Recovered_extreme","Chronic_extreme")) %>%
  mutate(External_Group = factor(External_Group, c("Recovered_extreme","Chronic_extreme")))

table(RRS_validation_extreme_only$External_Group)

t.test(RRS ~ External_Group, data = RRS_validation_extreme_only)
# t = 2.4219, df = 47.857, p-value = 0.01928


RRS_validation_comb <- RRS_validation %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "PainOMICs (External)") %>%
  dplyr::select(Cohort, IndividualID, Outcome, RRS) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Participant ID` = IndividualID) %>%
  arrange(desc(RRS))

RRS_full_cohort_comb <- RRS_full_cohort %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "AURORA (Discovery)") %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Participant ID` = PID, 
                Outcome = Group) %>%
  arrange(desc(RRS))

RRS_combined_data <- rbind(RRS_full_cohort_comb, RRS_validation_comb) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cohort, `Participant ID`, RRS, Outcome)


#write.csv(RRS_combined_data, "RNA-based Recovery Score Final/AURORA and PainOMICs RRS Data.csv")
```

### Plot external RRS distributions
RRS distributions in the external PainOMICs cohort were visualized using boxplots with overlaid individual participant values. The plot compares participants with resolved versus persistent pain outcomes following application of the locked AURORA-derived RRS. Statistical annotations indicate group-level differences in RRS distributions between outcome groups.
```{r}
# p-value for external cohort
p_ext_label <- "p = 0.038"

RRS_validation <- RRS_validation %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Resolved", "Persistent"),
                           labels = c("Resolved\n(n = 48)", "Persistent\n(n = 49)")))

# colors
external_colors <- c("Resolved\n(n = 48)" = "#2698B1", "Persistent\n(n = 49)" = "#8D1946")

# external cohort plot
p_external <- RRS_validation %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Outcome, y = RRS, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Outcome), width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE, color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Outcome), width = 0.12, size = 1, 
              alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 1.5, 
               fill = "black", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = external_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = external_colors) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = -1.25, label = p_ext_label, size = 2.5) +
  labs(title = "External Cohort\n(PainOMICs)", x = NULL, y = "RRS") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(r = -5), vjust = -0.4),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size =7),
    legend.position = "none")

p_external

```


## Figure 5 
```{r}
p_train_com <- p_train + 
      theme(plot.margin = margin(t=0,b=0,l=5,r=3),
        axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = -1))

p_holdout_com <- p_holdout + 
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t=0,b=0,l=5,r=3),
        axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = -0.5))

p_external_com <- p_external + 
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t=0,b=0,l=5,r=3),
        axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2))

RRS_AUC_com <- RRS_AUC + 
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t=3,b=0,l=5,r=3),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = 10), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = -0.5))

RRS_distributions_combined <- ggarrange(p_train_com, p_holdout_com, p_external_com, RRS_AUC_com,  nrow = 1, align = "h", widths = c(1.8, 2.75, 1.8, 3.5))
ggsave(RRS_distributions_combined, filename = "Figures/RRS Validation Boxplots and AUC Barplots.jpg", width = 180, height = 50, units = "mm")
```
